notes:
Quick CRM summary:
- Mid-market product org (editor + conversational product features). evaluating Hosted API first (trial done) -> moving toward Dedicated for predictable latency/cost.
- Hosted API POC (Nov-Feb): onboarded 3 devs, integrated SDK, ran 2-week trial across staging and canary. Good dev velocity, hit quota limits twice on hosted.
- Workloads: mix of chat assistant (proactive guidance), doc search + summarization, and a reranker for search results. Approx "feature mix": chat 55%, search+summarize 30%, rerank 15%.
- Traffic profile observed on Hosted trial (prod-simulated load): typical steady QPS ~8-12 QPS; daily peak bursts ~85-120 QPS for 10-20s during feature launches; sustained peak windows up to 30 minutes at ~40 QPS.
- Concurrency and latency targets: target P95 latency <= 220ms for short-chat completions (<=512 tokens), target P95 <= 350ms for longer responses (avg 800 tokens). Current hosted P95 ~260ms (short) under test load.
- Token mix: avg input tokens per chat turn ~95, avg generated tokens ~280 -> avg roundtrip ~375 tokens. Search summarization requests average 420 input tokens (docs) -> generation ~120 tokens. Reranker calls are short (avg 45 tokens) but executed in batches of 16. Embeddings volume small (background indexing), ~6% of total calls but high token-per-call for long docs.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; team wants unit economics for 2-year runway. Interested in quantization/throughput tradeoffs. Prefers predictable monthly commit if Dedicated yields >30% token-cost reduction vs hosted.
- Routing/fallback: wants auto-fallback to hosted for burst overflow; origin routing by region (NA primary, EU for EU customers) and model family (fast cheaper variant vs high-quality variant).
- Security ask: SSO/SAML setup already validated; main ask is KMS/HSM integration and S3 log retention controls for audit. Need SOC2 evidence and optional ISO27001.
- Quote from VP Product: "We need inference to feel invisible to customers — 200ms-ish responses for common flows; cost matters for scaling subscriber tiers."
- POC milestones completed: Hosted sandbox/trial, sample traffic replay, latency profiles, initial security questionnaire. Outstanding: dedicated sizing plan, dedicated pricing for committed capacity + burst, legal SLA draft.
- Internal stakeholders: VP Product (decision), Head of Infra (technical sign-off), Procurement (negotiates terms).
- Recommended Redwood play: propose 2-tier Dedicated pool: baseline (4 GPUs equivalent) sized for steady 12 QPS with caching + batching optimizations, plus 2-bucket burst pool to handle 120 QPS short bursts using autoscaling/burst credits. Provide costing scenarios: (A) 6 GPU commit + burst credits (B) 10 GPU commit (lower per-token but higher fixed). Include model variants and quantization trade-offs for cost/latency.
- Action items: Lindsey to deliver Detailed Dedicated Sizing doc (includes QPS->GPU mapping, expected token throughput, concurrency targets) by 2026-03-05. AE (Ravi) to prep pricing scenarios and T&Cs. Schedule procurement call w/ Finance for week of 2026-03-10.
- Short notes from call 2026-02-13 (ff-20260213-ck9v2): "liked the burst credits idea, wants concrete numbers for 6 vs 10 GPU commit. Needs example monthly invoice breakdown."
